title: Saggar — know which terminal needs you
excerpt: A native Mac terminal that keeps projects, sessions, and attention organized. Saggar tracks what is working, waiting, finished, and failed, then brings the sessions that need you to the front.
content_html:
A native Mac terminal that keeps projects, sessions, and attention organized.

Run shells, dev servers, tests, and coding agents across several projects while Saggar tracks what is working, waiting, finished, and failed. Sessions that need a decision stay visible without pulling you away from the terminal you are using. Pair the Companion to check in and respond from your phone while you are away.

Mac only. Requires macOS 26 Tahoe or later on Apple silicon.

Running one agent is easy. Running five is supervision.

One agent is editing while another runs tests. A third has quietly stopped at a permission prompt, and a fourth finished ten minutes ago with changes to review. In a normal terminal, they all look like tabs. You find the blocked one when you happen to look.

Saggar keeps every state visible, folds away the quiet work, and builds one queue from everything that needs a decision.

The intro

The supervision loop

Start work across projects

Run agents, shells, dev servers, and tests across every codebase. Each session stays attached to its project, branch, and worktree.

Leave working agents alone

Sessions classify themselves as needs you, working, idle, finished, or failed. Quiet work folds away while the claims on you stay visible.

Clear the human queue

Waiting prompts and finished work form one ordered queue. Answer from the attention card, or press ⌘J to walk it from loudest to quietest.

Step away without losing the thread

Pair the Companion to see what your sessions are doing while you are out. Inspect a terminal, answer its prompt, interrupt a runaway, or type into it.

Tending from anywhere

  1. Sign in on both. The same Marginal Utility account on the Mac and on the phone. That match is what pairing allows, and the Mac checks it again on every request.
  2. Scan the QR code. Saggar → Settings → Remote control shows it, carrying an opaque Mac identifier and the live code, so nothing is transcribed. The account check runs first, then the Mac asks you to approve the device.
  3. Once, and then not again. Grants do not expire on their own — a phone in a pocket for six weeks is still paired. Signing the Mac out revokes every device at once, and any device can be revoked on its own.

Security that says no by default

Remote control ships on, because a feature you have to find and arm first is one nobody has armed by the time they need it. What says no is the account: nothing pairs that is not signed in as you.

your account, both ends

A device pairs only while it is signed in as you — checked on every request.

nothing listens

The Mac dials out to the relay. It opens no port on your network.

one-time pairing

One scan, and it holds. Signing the Mac out revokes every device at once.

sealed traffic

Terminal requests and responses are encrypted end to end through the relay.

Documentation

Start with the setup guide, learn the common workflows, or look up a command when you need it.

Already have Saggar?

Follow the setup guide, or open the remote client for a paired Mac.

content_html_zh:
一个原生 Mac 终端，可让项目、会议和注意力井井有条。

在多个项目中运行 shell、开发服务器、测试和编码代理，而 Saggar 则跟踪正在运行、等待、完成和失败的内容。 需要做出决定的会话保持可见，而不会让您离开正在使用的终端。 与 Companion 配对，以便在您离开时通过手机查看并回复。

仅限苹果电脑。 需要 Apple 芯片上的 macOS 26 Tahoe 或更高版本。

运行一个代理很容易。 跑五是监督。

一名代理正在编辑，而另一名代理则运行测试。 第三个在出现许可提示时悄悄停下来，第四个在十分钟前完成并进行了更改以供审核。 在普通终端中，它们看起来都像选项卡。 当你碰巧查看时，你会发现被封锁的那个。

Saggar 保持每个状态可见，折叠安静的工作，并从所有需要决策的事物中构建一个队列。

简介

监督循环

开始跨项目工作

跨每个代码库运行代理、shell、开发服务器和测试。 每个会话都与其项目、分支和工作树保持关联。

让工作代理独自一人

会话根据您的需要、工作、空闲、完成或失败进行分类。 安静的工作消失了，而对你的要求仍然可见。

清除人员队列

等待提示和完成的工作形成一个有序的队列。 从注意卡上回答，或按 ⌘J 从最响亮到最安静。

走开而不失去线索

与 Companion 配对，查看您外出时的会话正在做什么。 检查终端，回答其提示，中断失控，或在终端中输入内容。

随时随地进行护理

  1. 两者都登录。 Mac 和手机上的边际效用帐户相同。 配对允许这种匹配，Mac 会根据每个请求再次检查它。
  2. 扫描二维码。 Saggar → 设置 → 远程控制显示它，带有不透明的 Mac 标识符和实时代码，因此没有任何内容被转录。 首先运行帐户检查，然后 Mac 会要求您批准该设备。
  3. 一次，然后就不会再有第二次了。 赠款不会自行过期——放在口袋里六周的手机仍然可以配对。 注销 Mac 会立即撤销所有设备，并且任何设备都可以单独撤销。

安全性默认拒绝

远程控制功能已上线，因为您必须首先找到并启用的功能是在需要时无人启用的功能。 说“不”的是帐户：没有任何配对不是以您的身份登录的。

您的帐户，两端

设备仅在以您身份登录时配对 - 根据每个请求进行检查。

没有人听

Mac 拨出到中继。 它不会在您的网络上打开任何端口。

一次性配对

扫描一下，就可以了。 注销 Mac 会同时撤销所有设备。

封闭交通

终端请求和响应通过中继进行端到端加密。

文档

从设置指南开始，了解常见的工作流程，或者在需要时查找命令。

已经有萨格了吗？

按照设置指南操作，或打开配对 Mac 的远程客户端。
